mapper.delete: DELETE FROM character_states WHERE novel_id=#{novelId} AND chapter_no=#{chapterNo}
mapper.select:
INSERT INTO character_states (novel_id, chapter_no, name, location, possessions) VALUES (#{novelId}, #{chapterNo}, #{name}, #{location},
#{possessions}::jsonb NULL ) ON CONFLICT (novel_id, chapter_no, name) WHERE is_deleted = FALSE DO UPDATE SET location = EXCLUDED.location, possessions = EXCLUDED.possessions, update_time = now() RETURNING 1

SELECT id, novel_id AS "novelId", chapter_no AS "chapterNo", name, location, possessions, create_time AS "createTime", update_time AS "updateTime" FROM character_states WHERE novel_id=#{novelId} AND chapter_no=#{chapterNo} ORDER BY name

SELECT id, novel_id AS "novelId", chapter_no AS "chapterNo", name, location, possessions, create_time AS "createTime", update_time AS "updateTime" FROM character_states WHERE novel_id=#{novelId} ORDER BY chapter_no, name

SELECT id, novel_id AS "novelId", chapter_no AS "chapterNo", name, location, possessions, create_time AS "createTime", update_time AS "updateTime" FROM character_states WHERE novel_id=#{novelId} AND name=#{name} AND chapter_no < #{beforeChapter} ORDER BY chapter_no DESC LIMIT 1
